steps.reason: TotalCharges is stored as text with 11 non-numeric entries and no step can convert it. It correlates 0.9996 with tenure times MonthlyCharges, which are kept, so almost nothing is lost.
Stratified: only 26% of the customers churn.
Every remaining text column has two to four values and no missing values; one-hot is the family-neutral encoding. PhoneService is a yes/no column, not personal data.

Tenure (months) and MonthlyCharges are on different scales and neither has strong outliers. The model family is open and may include linear models; scaling costs trees nothing and puts linear models on comparable footing.
